heading.en: Contour lines of the electric world

hook.en: On a map, contour lines join places at the same height. Equipotential surfaces join points at the same potential, and moving a charge along one costs no work at all.
hook.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮೋನ್ನತಿ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಎತ್ತರದ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ವಿಭವದ ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಲು ಕೆಲಸ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Describe equipotential surfaces and their relation to E.
Find the potential energy of a system of charges and of a dipole in a field.

narration.en: On a map, contour lines join places at the same height. Equipotential surfaces join points at the same potential, and moving a charge along one costs no work at all.
narration.kn: ನಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮೋನ್ನತಿ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಎತ್ತರದ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ವಿಭವದ ಬಿಂದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಲು ಕೆಲಸ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: An equipotential surface has the same potential at every point. No work is done in moving a charge along it, so the field is always perpendicular to it. For a point charge the equipotentials are concentric spheres; for a uniform field they are parallel planes perpendicular to E. E points from higher to lower potential, and its size is the potential drop per unit perpendicular distance.
body.kn: ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಿಂದುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭವ ಒಂದೇ. ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಏಕಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಗೋಳಗಳು; ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಸಮತಲಗಳು.

points.en: Point charge: concentric spheres; uniform E: parallel planes

narration.en: An equipotential surface has the same potential everywhere, so no work is done along it and the field is always perpendicular to it. Point charges give spheres; a uniform field gives parallel planes.
narration.kn: ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಬಿಂದುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಭವ ಒಂದೇ. ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಬಿಂದು ಆವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಏಕಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಗೋಳಗಳು; ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಸಮತಲಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: equipotentials and potential energy

narration.en: Equipotential surfaces join points at the same potential; round a point charge they are concentric spheres. No work is done in moving a charge along an equipotential, so the field must cut it at right angles. In a uniform field the equipotentials are parallel planes, and E = ΔV/Δr points towards lower potential. The potential energy of two charges is kq₁q₂/r: positive for like charges, negative for unlike ones. Example: 7 μC and −2 μC, 18 cm apart, have U = −0.7 J; 0.7 J of work would pull them apart.

say.en: Equipotential surfaces join points at the same potential; round a point charge they are concentric spheres.
No work is done in moving a charge along an equipotential, so the field must cut it at right angles.
In a uniform field the equipotentials are parallel planes, and E = ΔV/Δr points towards lower potential.
The potential energy of two charges is kq₁q₂/r: positive for like charges, negative for unlike ones.
Example: 7 μC and −2 μC, 18 cm apart, have U = −0.7 J; 0.7 J of work would pull them apart.

narration.en: Drag q2. The system's potential energy U = k q1 q2 / r is the work done to assemble the charges from far apart. Like charges: U is positive and grows as they come closer. Unlike charges: U is negative and the system is bound. The graph shows U against r.

caption.en: Drag q2. The system's potential energy U = k q1 q2 / r is the work done to assemble the charges from far apart. Like charges: U is positive and grows as they come closer. Unlike charges: U is negative and the system is bound. The graph shows U against r.
caption.kn: q2 ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ. ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = k q1 q2 / r ಎಂದರೆ ದೂರದಿಂದ ಆವೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಲು ಮಾಡಿದ ಕೆಲಸ. ಸಜಾತೀಯ: U ಧನ, ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದಂತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು. ವಿಜಾತೀಯ: U ಋಣ, ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಬಂಧಿತ. ನಕ್ಷೆ U ಮತ್ತು r.

tryThis.en: With unlike charges, how much work must you do to pull q2 far away?
tryThis.kn: ವಿಜಾತೀಯ ಆವೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ q2 ಅನ್ನು ದೂರಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯಲು ಎಷ್ಟು ಕೆಲಸ ಬೇಕು?

tryThis.en: Halve the distance. What happens to U and to the force?
tryThis.kn: ದೂರ ಅರ್ಧ ಮಾಡಿ. U ಮತ್ತು ಬಲ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

tryThis.en: Move q2 in a circle around q1. Does U change? Why?
tryThis.kn: q2 ಅನ್ನು q1 ಸುತ್ತ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಸಿ. U ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆಯೇ? ಏಕೆ?

body.en: The potential energy of two charges is the work needed to bring them from infinity to separation r: $U = kq_1q_2/r$ (negative for unlike charges). For three or more charges, add this over every pair. A charge q in an external potential V has energy qV. A dipole in a uniform field has $U = -pE\cos\theta$: lowest (−pE) when aligned. Work needed to turn it from θ₁ to θ₂ is $pE(\cos\theta_1 - \cos\theta_2)$.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಆವೇಶಗಳ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಜ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = kq₁q₂/r; ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = −pE cosθ; ಸಾಲಾದಾಗ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ.

points.en: Many charges: sum over all pairs
W(θ₁ → θ₂) = pE(cos θ₁ − cos θ₂)

narration.en: The potential energy of two charges is k q1 q2 by r; for many charges add over every pair. A dipole in a field has energy minus p E cos theta, lowest when it lines up with the field.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಆವೇಶಗಳ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಜ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = kq₁q₂/r; ಅನೇಕ ಆವೇಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = −pE cosθ; ಸಾಲಾದಾಗ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ.

caption.en: U = 0.9 q₁q₂/r joule, with q in μC and r in cm. Positive U: like charges, the system was pushed together. Negative U: unlike charges, it is bound.

tryThis.en: Set 7 μC, −2 μC and 18 cm: U = −0.7 J, as on the board.
Make both charges positive: U turns positive. Who has to do work to bring them closer?
Halve r: U doubles, because U goes as 1/r (not 1/r²).

problem.en: Find the work needed to bring three charges of 2 μC each from infinity to the corners of an equilateral triangle of side 10 cm.

steps.en: There are three pairs, each at r = 0.1 m.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the work needed to bring three charges of 2 μC each from infinity to the corners of an equilateral triangle of side 10 cm.

problem.en: A dipole of moment 5 × 10⁻⁸ C m is aligned with a uniform field of 2 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹. How much work is needed to turn it through 180°?

steps.en: W = pE(cos θ₁ − cos θ₂) with θ₁ = 0°, θ₂ = 180°.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A dipole of moment 5 × 10⁻⁸ C m is aligned with a uniform field of 2 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹. How much work is needed to turn it through 180°?

body.en: From aligned (θ = 0°) to perpendicular costs pE; from aligned to opposite (180°) costs 2pE. Use W = pE(cos θ₁ − cos θ₂) for any other angles.

narration.en: Flipping a dipole costs 2pE. From aligned (θ = 0°) to perpendicular costs pE; from aligned to opposite (180°) costs 2pE. Use W = pE(cos θ₁ − cos θ₂) for any other angles.

homework.en: Four charges +q, −q, +q, −q sit at the corners of a square of side a (alternating). Find the potential energy of the system.

narration.en: Recap. Equipotential surfaces are always perpendicular to E. No work is done moving a charge along an equipotential. U = kq₁q₂/r for each pair; add over all pairs. Dipole: U = −pE cos θ; flipping it costs 2pE.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಗಳು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ E ಗೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಮವಿಭವ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈ ಮೇಲೆ ಆವೇಶವನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಲು ಕೆಲಸ ಶೂನ್ಯ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಜೋಡಿಗೆ U = kq₁q₂/r; ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಜೋಡಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ: U = −pE cosθ; ತಿರುವು ಹಾಕಲು 2pE ಕೆಲಸ.
